Logic: Partner Compensation Reconciliation -- Logic
Financial year: 2025-26
The seven legs (each an independent source; see Reconciliation):
1. Year-end position -- Compensation Advisory + LLP capital/current account statement.
2. Incentive schedule -- the firm's payment-schedule PDF (per-month grid).
3. Monthly payouts -- 12 monthly payout advices, plus payslips for any payroll months.
4. Capital contribution -- derived by rule, cross-checked to the Advisory's stated closing.
5. Bank -- the partner's bank statement credits.
6. One-offs -- special incentive / ex-gratia, appearing on a single month's advice.
7. The return -- filed ITR + computation + Form 26AS + Form 16.
Governing identity (derived every month, never read off the advice):
misc = total_paid - remuneration - share_of_profit_gross - additional_share_of_profit
A one-off ('Additional Share of Profit') is shown net of the firm's tax; it is
grossed up as gross = net / (1 - firms_tax_rate), then checked for roundness
(distance to the nearest Rs 100,000) -- a one-off is always awarded round.
Capital rule: required_cumulative_capital = target_compensation *
(months_achieved / months_total) * capital_rate. Deducted only when an
instalment is actually paid, never when awarded.
Non-goals: no tax computation, no .gnucash writes, no ITR workbook injection.
No rate, percentage or period is ever a constant -- every one is read from the
Drivers sheet / this run's input, and a missing one produces an explicit
CANNOT RECONCILE row rather than a default or a guess.
